description: Look up a band or solo performer across all 50 US states, Washington, DC, and British Columbia. With All Access, returns the artist dossier (genres, live draw / room-cap estimate, bio, typical headlining ticket price, booking/management contacts, website/socials, and top co-billed peers) plus every venue with past or upcoming show listings, dates, and source URLs. With a signed-in free account, returns aggregate show and venue counts across states. Anonymous callers are prompted to sign in.

include_possible.description: Include fuzzy / possible lineup matches (default false).

performer.description: Band or solo artist name to search.

state.description: Optional two-letter state/jurisdiction code (all 50 US states, "DC", "BC") or full name.

name: find_by_performer
title: Find Venues by Performer
